# Build storage retention

Owner-approved policy (2026-11-28): Windows executable or distributable Windows ZIP artifacts expire after 3 days; temporary reports, source/test artifacts expire after 1 day. Workflow logs: repository Actions retention 7 days. Publish only verified stable releases, retaining latest and previous stable per independent application. GHCR: retain latest verified working image and previous stable image per package, plus every deployed or pinned digest. Never delete artifacts needed by active builds, releases or packages referenced by deployments, or rollback dependencies. Failed/test candidates cannot replace stable versions. No automatic release/package deletion until deployment inventory and rollback verification exist; fail closed when unknown. GitHub repository Actions settings must be configured separately.
